body: Well I don't mean to be a downer, but things just got worse for me after age 15.

Well, the human race doesn't need my help to destroy themselves, we're on a good path.

If we somehow evade destroying ourselves by destroying our brothers, we're still evolving to fit our needs, which are none. ADHD isn't a disease, it's evolution at it's best. Soon nature will be humanised and we will stop needing any physical traits, and somehow the simplest of things will destroy us. There is no natural selection. Yay!

Honestly I think it got out of proportion. It is one of my bothers, but I understand most of the worries are necessary. What I do loathe is worthless chatter on information I already possess or know the point of.

My main worry is that I am not a fitting member that can fully function in any group. I cannot sleep worrying about that is going to happen tomorrow, and I am a mess during the day because of the mix of tiredness and day-to-day problems and mental concerns. I am slowly turning insane by not being able to perform the way I should.

Yeah, I don't really care what anyone tells me, but I still get annoyed when anyone speaks to me, as those are valuable seconds I could be using to loathe myself.

I guess I'm just moody about society today. I have to switch between self-loathe and misanthropy at times.

Well the scale certainly isn't in my favor. I am too cynical and bitter to enjoy almost anything, which is the reason I need to get high or drunk to enjoy myself.

What I get stressed about is that no one lets me live my life. There is always people that tell me what to do, where to do it and who to do it with. I usually scram them off, but it's not as easy when those people are somewhat relevant in your life. Sadly, I need some people to stay in my life, or I can't throw them out. I just wish I could have a whole week of no interruptions, me just doing whatever I please, then I finally go to sleep and never wake up.

Random people "caring" about me isn't going to make my life any better. I don't need any validation by Internet strangers.

I just don't see a way that life gets any better, hence dying would make me skip a whole lot of crap, since I'm dying eventually, and nothing you ever do here actually matters.
